newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end lower on political jitters.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end lower on political jitters.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished lower on Sunday as major investors kept to the sidelines amid political uncertainty, dealers said.
Speculation that the polls scheduled for February 3 may be delayed scared away investors already unsure of the political situation, dealer Ali Asghar of Fortune Securities said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 18.86 points, or 1.29 percent, to close at 1,441.72. Losers led gainers 177 to 75.
FFC Jordan Fertilizer fell 0.25 rupees to 14.75 and Dewan Salman Fibre 0.80 to 35.80. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
